rows.note: net business income of individuals (art. 21); individuals with turnover up to BIF 25 million pay 1% of quarterly turnover in 2026-27 (finance law art. 190).

rows.label: Employee contributions to qualified pension funds: deductible up to 20% of gross pay
rows.note: employee share of contributions to qualified pension funds and complementary social security bodies (art. 33); contributions to the State social security funds and health insurance are deductible in full.

source.title: Loi n° 1/14 du 24 décembre 2020 portant modification de la loi n° 1/02 du 24 janvier 2013 relative aux impôts sur les revenus

rows.label: Housing allowance up to 60% and travel allowance up to 15% of base salary deductible
rows.value: Travel allowances up to 15% of base salary (unless transport is provided in kind) and housing allowances up to 60% of base salary are deductible from taxable employment income; employer pension and health contributions and medical reimbursements are excluded from it.

sections.basis: severance, loss-of-employment, end-of-career, retirement and contract-termination payments (art. 117)

rows.label: IRE withheld by the employer and paid within 15 days of the month end
rows.value: The main employer withholds the employment income tax from monthly pay and, within 15 calendar days after the end of each month, files a return and pays the tax withheld to the OBR.

source.title: Loi n° 1/14 du 24 décembre 2020 portant modification de la loi n° 1/02 du 24 janvier 2013 relative aux impôts sur les revenus

rows.label: Secondary employer: 30% withholding
rows.note: monthly taxable employment income paid by an employer who is not the employee's main employer (art. 118).

source.title: Loi n° 1/14 du 24 décembre 2020 portant modification de la loi n° 1/02 du 24 janvier 2013 relative aux impôts sur les revenus

rows.label: Casual employees: 15% (first BIF 150,000 a month at 0%)

rows.label: Non-residents: same scale for employment and rental income
rows.value: Non-residents are taxed on their Burundi-source employment and rental income at the same scale as residents.

sections.title: Dividends, interest and payments to non-residents

rows.label: Withholding tax on dividends: 15%
rows.note: dividends and profit shares paid by a resident company to another resident company, to shareholders or to employees (art. 122 of the income tax law as amended by finance law art. 156).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Withholding tax on interest: 15%
rows.note: interest of any kind, except interest paid between banks, financial institutions and microfinance institutions subject to income tax (finance law art. 156).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Withholding tax on royalties: 15%
rows.note: royalties, except those paid to the State (finance law art. 156, 3°); vehicle and equipment rentals are also subject (6°).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Withholding tax on services by non-residents: 15%
rows.note: fees for services supplied by non-residents and study, head-office, technical, financial or accounting fees paid to non-residents, not attributable to a permanent establishment in Burundi; final for non-residents (income tax law arts. 22 and 102).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Treasury bills and bonds: interest and gains exempt (2026-27)
rows.value: Interest on Treasury bills and bonds, and capital gains on Treasury securities sold on the secondary market, are exempt from income tax in 2026-27.

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Tax on the employment of foreign workers
rows.note: annual gross salary of each foreign worker; borne by the employer and paid by 31 March each year (finance law art. 103).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Special contribution of 0.5% (school equipment, teachers and health card)
rows.note: net monthly pay of staff of donor-funded projects and of senior appointees, net allowances of political office holders, and amounts paid on public contracts (finance law art. 71).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Corporate income tax
rows.note: taxable profit of companies, rounded to the nearest thousand francs (art. 103).

source.title: Loi n° 1/14 du 24 décembre 2020 portant modification de la loi n° 1/02 du 24 janvier 2013 relative aux impôts sur les revenus

rows.label: Minimum tax: 1% of turnover
rows.note: turnover, when taxable income is below turnover divided by 30; free-zone companies exempt for their first ten years (arts. 21 and 103).

source.title: Loi n° 1/14 du 24 décembre 2020 portant modification de la loi n° 1/02 du 24 janvier 2013 relative aux impôts sur les revenus

rows.label: Listed companies: reduced corporate tax of 28%, 25% or 20% (2026-27)
rows.value: Companies listed on an approved Burundian stock exchange pay corporate tax at 28% when at least 20% of their share capital is offered to the public, 25% from 30% and 20% from 40%; listing costs are deductible.

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Related-party interest: deductible up to 30% of taxable profit (2026-27)
rows.value: Interest on loans and advances from related persons is not deductible to the extent it exceeds 30% of taxable profit before that interest; accrued unpaid interest between related persons is not deductible.

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
Loi n° 1/14 du 24 décembre 2020 portant modification de la loi n° 1/02 du 24 janvier 2013 relative aux impôts sur les revenus

rows.label: TVA: compulsory registration from taxable turnover of BIF 25 million
rows.note: taxable turnover in a financial year (finance law art. 271); TVA is charged from the first day of the month after the threshold is reached.

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: TVA: voluntary registration from turnover of BIF 5 million
rows.note: turnover, registration by option (finance law art. 271).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: TVA: liable when local purchases or imports exceed BIF 50 million
rows.note: local purchases and/or imports in a financial year, or stock held, above BIF 50 million (excluding investments and personal effects): automatic TVA registration as a medium or large taxpayer (finance law art. 271).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: TVA and import exemptions for electric and hybrid vehicles (2026-27)
rows.value: Electric vehicles, motorcycles and tricycles are exempt from all import duties, taxes and fees; hybrids are exempt from consumption tax and import TVA; spare parts exclusively for them and their fitting and repair are exempt from TVA.

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: TVA on sugar: 10%
rows.note: sugar, imported or locally produced (finance law art. 90); the consumption tax on sugar is abolished and customs duty set at 25%.

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: TVA on banking and financial operations abolished
rows.value: TVA on banking and financial operations is abolished; they bear the 8% tax on financial activities instead.

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Consumption tax on cigarettes: BIF 40 per stick
rows.note: cigarettes containing tobacco, locally produced or imported (a specific tax replacing the ad valorem consumption tax; finance law art. 130). Unit: per cigarette.

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Consumption tax on other imported tobacco products
rows.value: Other imported tobacco products pay consumption tax by tariff heading: 2404.11.00 BIF 30 a piece, 2404.12.00 BIF 200 a millilitre, 2403.99.00 BIF 24,000 a kilogram and 2404.91.00 BIF 40,000 a kilogram.

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Consumption tax on beer: BIF 40,000 per hectolitre
rows.note: beer, imported or locally produced; BIF 12,430 per hectolitre for beer made with 100% local raw materials (finance law art. 90). Unit: per hectolitre.

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Consumption tax on spirits and liqueurs: BIF 500 per litre
rows.note: alcohol, liqueurs and other drinks of tariff headings 2208.20.00 to 2208.90.90; sparkling wines also BIF 500 per litre, other wines BIF 130 per litre (finance law art. 90). Unit: per litre.

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Ad valorem consumption tax on wines and liqueurs: 80% to 200%
rows.value: On top of the specific tax, wines and liqueurs bear an ad valorem consumption tax: sparkling wines other than champagne 100%, champagnes and liqueurs 200%, other wines 80% (on the CIF value plus customs duty for imports, on the sale price for local products).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Consumption tax on soft drinks and juices: BIF 30,400 per hectolitre
rows.note: lemonades, sodas, juices of all kinds and other non-alcoholic drinks (finance law art. 90). Unit: per hectolitre.

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Consumption tax on mineral and sparkling water: 13%
rows.note: mineral and sparkling waters, flavoured or not (finance law art. 90).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Consumption tax on fuel: BIF 210 per litre
rows.note: fuel, imported or locally produced; lubricants BIF 300 per litre (finance law art. 90). Unit: per litre.

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Road levy: BIF 75 per litre of fuel
rows.note: fuel consumed (finance law art. 113). Unit: per litre.

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Services consumption tax on notaries' and lawyers' fees: 10%
rows.note: fees charged by notaries and lawyers, collected by them and paid monthly by the 15th (finance law art. 72).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Gambling levies: 10% of deposits, withdrawals and gross profit
rows.value: Gambling of all kinds bears a 10% levy on deposits for each type of game (sports and virtual), 10% on players' withdrawals, a contribution of 10% of the gross profit of gambling companies and 10% of the prizes of occasional and promotional games (tombolas).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Levy of 10% on digital platforms' Burundi-source revenue
rows.note: Burundi-source revenue of streaming, VOIP and e-commerce platforms serving users in Burundi (finance law art. 168).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Tax on financial activities (TAF): 8%
rows.note: net banking or financial income of banks, financial institutions, microfinance institutions, financial intermediaries and foreign-exchange dealers; declared and paid monthly by the 15th; not deductible for income tax (finance law arts. 174 to 185).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Levy of 22% on mobile financial services fees
rows.note: fees for mobile financial services, borne by the platform owners (finance law art. 186).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Annual contribution of insurance companies: 1.5% of premiums
rows.note: gross premiums of the previous year net of cancellations; not deductible; paid by 31 March (finance law art. 152).

sections.title: Telecom, energy and other special consumption taxes

rows.label: Mobile call tax: BIF 52 per minute
rows.note: national mobile call minutes; TVA and consumption tax on call minutes are abolished (finance law art. 132); BIF 5 per mobile message (art. 133). Unit: per minute.

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Tax on mobile data services: 18%
rows.note: charges for mobile data services, replacing TVA (finance law art. 166); value-added electronic communication services 20% (art. 187).

sections.title: Property acquisition, transfer and registration taxes

rows.label: Wealth tax on acquisitions of property worth BIF 500 million or more: 5%
rows.note: value excluding TVA of a building or plot, built or not, whose market or counter-valuation value is at least BIF 500 million; 5% (10% when worth BIF 500 million or more) from the third property; borne by the buyer (finance law art. 146).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Consumption tax on passenger cars: 7%, 12% or 17%
rows.value: Passenger cars of tariff heading 87.03 (except ambulances, prison vans and hearses) pay a consumption tax of 7% (petrol up to 1,500 cc, diesel up to 1,500 cc), 12% (petrol 1,501 to 3,000 cc, diesel 1,501 to 2,500 cc) or 17% (larger engines and other vehicles); utility vehicles and vehicles moved by returning nationals are exempt.

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Wealth tax on imported cars of 3,500 cc and more: 5%
rows.note: customs value of imported passenger cars of 3,500 cc or more, except exempt importers; doubled, tripled and so on from the second vehicle of the same type (finance law art. 146).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Anti-pollution penalty on imported vehicles aged 7 years or more
rows.note: each imported vehicle aged seven years or more, plus 5%, 10% or 15% of customs value by engine size (finance law art. 112).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Annual environmental fee on vehicles
rows.value: An annual flat environmental fee is due by 31 March: motorcycles BIF 10,000; tricycles and quadricycles BIF 20,000; vehicles up to 1,400 kg BIF 50,000, 1,401 to 2,500 kg BIF 100,000, 2,501 to 3,500 kg BIF 500,000, 3,501 to 9,000 kg BIF 1,000,000 and 9,001 kg or more BIF 1,500,000; public transport vehicles of more than 12 seats BIF 100,000; State, diplomatic and electric vehicles exempt.

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Services consumption tax on hotel accommodation: 5%
rows.note: accommodation rates excluding taxes charged by hotels, motels and guest houses; collected by the operator and paid monthly by the 15th (finance law art. 74).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Mortgage registration fee
rows.note: total amount of the secured claim or credit, for registration, renewal or transfer of a mortgage on registered property (finance law art. 148, amending the annex of law n° 1/05 of 20 February 2020 on land registration duties).

rows.label: Building permit tax: 1 per mille of the estimate
rows.note: approved estimate of a house built in urban areas (finance law art. 147).

sections.title: Freelancers, contractors and the self-employed

rows.label: Individuals with turnover up to BIF 25 million: 1% of quarterly turnover
rows.note: quarterly turnover of individuals whose annual turnover is at most BIF 25 million, declared quarterly; above BIF 25 million an annual return with simplified or full accounts (finance law art. 190, derogating from art. 41 of the income tax law).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Final flat levy on purchases from manufacturers
rows.value: A final flat income-tax levy is collected by manufacturers on local purchases from them: sugar 1% of the sale price; beer 1%, lemonades and juices 0.5%, wines 2%, fortified wines 50% and liqueurs 100% of the ex-factory price; mineral water 1%; flour 0.85%; local oils 2%; cigarettes 1%; fabrics 1%; palm kernel oil 2%; cement and building materials 2% of the commission; fuels and lubricants bought from importers 0.74%; parchment coffee 0.9%.

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Paid transport: quarterly final flat tax
rows.value: Paid transport operators not required to keep full accounts pay a final flat income tax each quarter: lorries BIF 39,000 (under 7 tonnes), BIF 54,000 (7 to 10 tonnes) or BIF 200,000 (over 10 tonnes); buses BIF 54,000 (over 35 seats), BIF 39,000 (18 to 35) or BIF 24,000 (12 to 18); car taxis BIF 20,000; motor tricycles and motorcycle taxis BIF 15,000.

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Withholding of 4% on payments to public contractors
rows.note: invoice amount excluding TVA, on payments to holders of public contracts (except advances); taxpayers with a tax clearance certificate (quitus fiscal) are exempt (art. 121).

sections.title: Customs: de minimis, import taxes and traveller allowances

rows.label: Regional integration levy on imports from outside the African Union
rows.note: customs value of imports originating outside the African Union, except petroleum products and official, defence and donated imports (finance law art. 137).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Security levy on imports
rows.note: value of imported goods, except petroleum products and official, defence and donated imports (finance law art. 135).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Ad valorem tax of 1.5% on imports
rows.note: customs value of all imports, except imports exempt by law or treaty, by State-budget public services, fuel, listed foodstuffs and diplomatic imports (finance law art. 136).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Income tax prepayment of 3% on imports for resale
rows.note: customs value of imports for resale, except fuel; an instalment of income tax (finance law art. 75).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Administrative fee of 1% on imports
rows.note: customs value delivered to Burundi, paid by the importer (finance law art. 73); an IT fee of 0.25% of customs value is charged on each customs declaration (art. 110).

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Import surtaxes on drinks, dairy, fabrics and building materials
rows.value: Surtaxes on the customs value of imports: beer and mineral or sparkling water 100% (plus a further 50% on beer), lemonades, sodas, non-alcoholic drinks and juices 25%, liquid milk and dairy products except powdered milk 30%, imported fabrics and mineral water a further 20%, corrugated sheets and nails not meeting EAC or COMESA origin rules 20%, steel bars, wood, plastic chairs and tables, A4 paper, wooden furniture, tubes and pipes 10%, tiles, cement, ceilings and maize 15%, ethyl alcohol 10%.

source.title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027

rows.label: Export tax on raw hides: 80% of FOB value or USD 0.52 per kg
rows.value: Raw hides and skins pay an export tax of 80% of the FOB value or USD 0.52 per kilogram, whichever is higher.

rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/14 du 24 décembre 2020 portant modification de la loi n° 1/02 du 24 janvier 2013 relative aux impôts sur les revenus
rows.label: Individuals with business income: single rate of 30%

rows.note: employee share of contributions to qualified pension funds and complementary social security bodies (art. 33); contributions to the State social security funds and health insurance are deductible in full.
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/14 du 24 décembre 2020 portant modification de la loi n° 1/02 du 24 janvier 2013 relative aux impôts sur les revenus
rows.label: Employee contributions to qualified pension funds: deductible up to 20% of gross pay

rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/14 du 24 décembre 2020 portant modification de la loi n° 1/02 du 24 janvier 2013 relative aux impôts sur les revenus
rows.label: Housing allowance up to 60% and travel allowance up to 15% of base salary deductible
rows.value: Travel allowances up to 15% of base salary (unless transport is provided in kind) and housing allowances up to 60% of base salary are deductible from taxable employment income; employer pension and health contributions and medical reimbursements are excluded from it.

rows.section: Severance, retirement and termination payments: 5%, 10% and 15%
rows.basis: severance, loss-of-employment, end-of-career, retirement and contract-termination payments (art. 117)
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/14 du 24 décembre 2020 portant modification de la loi n° 1/02 du 24 janvier 2013 relative aux impôts sur les revenus

rows.section: Severance, retirement and termination payments: 5%, 10% and 15%
rows.basis: severance, loss-of-employment, end-of-career, retirement and contract-termination payments (art. 117)
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/14 du 24 décembre 2020 portant modification de la loi n° 1/02 du 24 janvier 2013 relative aux impôts sur les revenus

rows.section: Severance, retirement and termination payments: 5%, 10% and 15%
rows.basis: severance, loss-of-employment, end-of-career, retirement and contract-termination payments (art. 117)
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/14 du 24 décembre 2020 portant modification de la loi n° 1/02 du 24 janvier 2013 relative aux impôts sur les revenus
Loi n° 1/14 du 24 décembre 2020 portant modification de la loi n° 1/02 du 24 janvier 2013 relative aux impôts sur les revenus
rows.label: IRE withheld by the employer and paid within 15 days of the month end
rows.value: The main employer withholds the employment income tax from monthly pay and, within 15 calendar days after the end of each month, files a return and pays the tax withheld to the OBR.

rows.note: monthly taxable employment income paid by an employer who is not the employee's main employer (art. 118).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/14 du 24 décembre 2020 portant modification de la loi n° 1/02 du 24 janvier 2013 relative aux impôts sur les revenus
rows.label: Secondary employer: 30% withholding

rows.note: monthly taxable employment income of casual employees (art. 119).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/14 du 24 décembre 2020 portant modification de la loi n° 1/02 du 24 janvier 2013 relative aux impôts sur les revenus
rows.label: Casual employees: 15% (first BIF 150,000 a month at 0%)

rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/14 du 24 décembre 2020 portant modification de la loi n° 1/02 du 24 janvier 2013 relative aux impôts sur les revenus
rows.label: Non-residents: same scale for employment and rental income
rows.value: Non-residents are taxed on their Burundi-source employment and rental income at the same scale as residents.

rows.note: capital income and capital gains of individuals, and the proceeds of sales of business assets (art. 23).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/14 du 24 décembre 2020 portant modification de la loi n° 1/02 du 24 janvier 2013 relative aux impôts sur les revenus
rows.label: Capital income and capital gains: 15%

rows.section: Dividends, interest and payments to non-residents
rows.note: dividends and profit shares paid by a resident company to another resident company, to shareholders or to employees (art. 122 of the income tax law as amended by finance law art. 156).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Withholding tax on dividends: 15%

rows.section: Dividends, interest and payments to non-residents
rows.note: interest of any kind, except interest paid between banks, financial institutions and microfinance institutions subject to income tax (finance law art. 156).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Withholding tax on interest: 15%

rows.section: Dividends, interest and payments to non-residents
rows.note: royalties, except those paid to the State (finance law art. 156, 3°); vehicle and equipment rentals are also subject (6°).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Withholding tax on royalties: 15%

rows.section: Dividends, interest and payments to non-residents
rows.note: fees for services supplied by non-residents and study, head-office, technical, financial or accounting fees paid to non-residents, not attributable to a permanent establishment in Burundi; final for non-residents (income tax law arts. 22 and 102).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Withholding tax on services by non-residents: 15%

rows.section: Dividends, interest and payments to non-residents
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Treasury bills and bonds: interest and gains exempt (2026-27)
rows.value: Interest on Treasury bills and bonds, and capital gains on Treasury securities sold on the secondary market, are exempt from income tax in 2026-27.

rows.note: annual gross salary of each foreign worker; borne by the employer and paid by 31 March each year (finance law art. 103).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Tax on the employment of foreign workers

rows.note: net monthly pay of staff of donor-funded projects and of senior appointees, net allowances of political office holders, and amounts paid on public contracts (finance law art. 71).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Special contribution of 0.5% (school equipment, teachers and health card)

rows.note: taxable profit of companies, rounded to the nearest thousand francs (art. 103).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/14 du 24 décembre 2020 portant modification de la loi n° 1/02 du 24 janvier 2013 relative aux impôts sur les revenus
rows.label: Corporate income tax

rows.note: turnover, when taxable income is below turnover divided by 30; free-zone companies exempt for their first ten years (arts. 21 and 103).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/14 du 24 décembre 2020 portant modification de la loi n° 1/02 du 24 janvier 2013 relative aux impôts sur les revenus
rows.label: Minimum tax: 1% of turnover

rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Listed companies: reduced corporate tax of 28%, 25% or 20% (2026-27)
rows.value: Companies listed on an approved Burundian stock exchange pay corporate tax at 28% when at least 20% of their share capital is offered to the public, 25% from 30% and 20% from 40%; listing costs are deductible.

rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Related-party interest: deductible up to 30% of taxable profit (2026-27)
rows.value: Interest on loans and advances from related persons is not deductible to the extent it exceeds 30% of taxable profit before that interest; accrued unpaid interest between related persons is not deductible.

rows.note: taxable turnover in a financial year (finance law art. 271); TVA is charged from the first day of the month after the threshold is reached.
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: TVA: compulsory registration from taxable turnover of BIF 25 million

rows.note: turnover, registration by option (finance law art. 271).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: TVA: voluntary registration from turnover of BIF 5 million

rows.note: local purchases and/or imports in a financial year, or stock held, above BIF 50 million (excluding investments and personal effects): automatic TVA registration as a medium or large taxpayer (finance law art. 271).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: TVA: liable when local purchases or imports exceed BIF 50 million

rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: TVA and import exemptions for electric and hybrid vehicles (2026-27)
rows.value: Electric vehicles, motorcycles and tricycles are exempt from all import duties, taxes and fees; hybrids are exempt from consumption tax and import TVA; spare parts exclusively for them and their fitting and repair are exempt from TVA.

rows.note: sugar, imported or locally produced (finance law art. 90); the consumption tax on sugar is abolished and customs duty set at 25%.
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: TVA on sugar: 10%

rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: TVA on banking and financial operations abolished
rows.value: TVA on banking and financial operations is abolished; they bear the 8% tax on financial activities instead.

rows.note: cigarettes containing tobacco, locally produced or imported (a specific tax replacing the ad valorem consumption tax; finance law art. 130). Unit: per cigarette.
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Consumption tax on cigarettes: BIF 40 per stick

rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Consumption tax on other imported tobacco products
rows.value: Other imported tobacco products pay consumption tax by tariff heading: 2404.11.00 BIF 30 a piece, 2404.12.00 BIF 200 a millilitre, 2403.99.00 BIF 24,000 a kilogram and 2404.91.00 BIF 40,000 a kilogram.

rows.note: beer, imported or locally produced; BIF 12,430 per hectolitre for beer made with 100% local raw materials (finance law art. 90). Unit: per hectolitre.
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Consumption tax on beer: BIF 40,000 per hectolitre

rows.note: alcohol, liqueurs and other drinks of tariff headings 2208.20.00 to 2208.90.90; sparkling wines also BIF 500 per litre, other wines BIF 130 per litre (finance law art. 90). Unit: per litre.
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Consumption tax on spirits and liqueurs: BIF 500 per litre

rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Ad valorem consumption tax on wines and liqueurs: 80% to 200%
rows.value: On top of the specific tax, wines and liqueurs bear an ad valorem consumption tax: sparkling wines other than champagne 100%, champagnes and liqueurs 200%, other wines 80% (on the CIF value plus customs duty for imports, on the sale price for local products).

rows.note: lemonades, sodas, juices of all kinds and other non-alcoholic drinks (finance law art. 90). Unit: per hectolitre.
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Consumption tax on soft drinks and juices: BIF 30,400 per hectolitre

rows.note: mineral and sparkling waters, flavoured or not (finance law art. 90).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Consumption tax on mineral and sparkling water: 13%

rows.note: fuel, imported or locally produced; lubricants BIF 300 per litre (finance law art. 90). Unit: per litre.
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Consumption tax on fuel: BIF 210 per litre

rows.note: fuel consumed (finance law art. 113). Unit: per litre.
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Road levy: BIF 75 per litre of fuel

rows.note: fees charged by notaries and lawyers, collected by them and paid monthly by the 15th (finance law art. 72).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Services consumption tax on notaries' and lawyers' fees: 10%

rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Gambling levies: 10% of deposits, withdrawals and gross profit
rows.value: Gambling of all kinds bears a 10% levy on deposits for each type of game (sports and virtual), 10% on players' withdrawals, a contribution of 10% of the gross profit of gambling companies and 10% of the prizes of occasional and promotional games (tombolas).

rows.section: Securities, insurance and digital services taxes
rows.note: Burundi-source revenue of streaming, VOIP and e-commerce platforms serving users in Burundi (finance law art. 168).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Levy of 10% on digital platforms' Burundi-source revenue

rows.section: Securities, insurance and digital services taxes
rows.note: net banking or financial income of banks, financial institutions, microfinance institutions, financial intermediaries and foreign-exchange dealers; declared and paid monthly by the 15th; not deductible for income tax (finance law arts. 174 to 185).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Tax on financial activities (TAF): 8%

rows.section: Securities, insurance and digital services taxes
rows.note: fees for mobile financial services, borne by the platform owners (finance law art. 186).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Levy of 22% on mobile financial services fees

rows.section: Securities, insurance and digital services taxes
rows.note: gross premiums of the previous year net of cancellations; not deductible; paid by 31 March (finance law art. 152).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Annual contribution of insurance companies: 1.5% of premiums

rows.section: Telecom, energy and other special consumption taxes
rows.note: national mobile call minutes; TVA and consumption tax on call minutes are abolished (finance law art. 132); BIF 5 per mobile message (art. 133). Unit: per minute.
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Mobile call tax: BIF 52 per minute

rows.section: Telecom, energy and other special consumption taxes
rows.note: charges for mobile data services, replacing TVA (finance law art. 166); value-added electronic communication services 20% (art. 187).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Tax on mobile data services: 18%

rows.section: Property acquisition, transfer and registration taxes
rows.note: value excluding TVA of a building or plot, built or not, whose market or counter-valuation value is at least BIF 500 million; 5% (10% when worth BIF 500 million or more) from the third property; borne by the buyer (finance law art. 146).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Wealth tax on acquisitions of property worth BIF 500 million or more: 5%

rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Consumption tax on passenger cars: 7%, 12% or 17%
rows.value: Passenger cars of tariff heading 87.03 (except ambulances, prison vans and hearses) pay a consumption tax of 7% (petrol up to 1,500 cc, diesel up to 1,500 cc), 12% (petrol 1,501 to 3,000 cc, diesel 1,501 to 2,500 cc) or 17% (larger engines and other vehicles); utility vehicles and vehicles moved by returning nationals are exempt.

rows.note: customs value of imported passenger cars of 3,500 cc or more, except exempt importers; doubled, tripled and so on from the second vehicle of the same type (finance law art. 146).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Wealth tax on imported cars of 3,500 cc and more: 5%

rows.note: each imported vehicle aged seven years or more, plus 5%, 10% or 15% of customs value by engine size (finance law art. 112).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Anti-pollution penalty on imported vehicles aged 7 years or more

rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Annual environmental fee on vehicles
rows.value: An annual flat environmental fee is due by 31 March: motorcycles BIF 10,000; tricycles and quadricycles BIF 20,000; vehicles up to 1,400 kg BIF 50,000, 1,401 to 2,500 kg BIF 100,000, 2,501 to 3,500 kg BIF 500,000, 3,501 to 9,000 kg BIF 1,000,000 and 9,001 kg or more BIF 1,500,000; public transport vehicles of more than 12 seats BIF 100,000; State, diplomatic and electric vehicles exempt.

rows.note: accommodation rates excluding taxes charged by hotels, motels and guest houses; collected by the operator and paid monthly by the 15th (finance law art. 74).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Services consumption tax on hotel accommodation: 5%

rows.note: total amount of the secured claim or credit, for registration, renewal or transfer of a mortgage on registered property (finance law art. 148, amending the annex of law n° 1/05 of 20 February 2020 on land registration duties).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Mortgage registration fee

rows.section: Broadcasting fee and statutory municipal charges
rows.note: approved estimate of a house built in urban areas (finance law art. 147).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Building permit tax: 1 per mille of the estimate

rows.note: quarterly turnover of individuals whose annual turnover is at most BIF 25 million, declared quarterly; above BIF 25 million an annual return with simplified or full accounts (finance law art. 190, derogating from art. 41 of the income tax law).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Individuals with turnover up to BIF 25 million: 1% of quarterly turnover

rows.note: Self-employed contributions, withholding on payments to freelancers and contractors, simplified regimes for small businesses, and expat and digital-nomad rules.
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Final flat levy on purchases from manufacturers
rows.value: A final flat income-tax levy is collected by manufacturers on local purchases from them: sugar 1% of the sale price; beer 1%, lemonades and juices 0.5%, wines 2%, fortified wines 50% and liqueurs 100% of the ex-factory price; mineral water 1%; flour 0.85%; local oils 2%; cigarettes 1%; fabrics 1%; palm kernel oil 2%; cement and building materials 2% of the commission; fuels and lubricants bought from importers 0.74%; parchment coffee 0.9%.

rows.note: Self-employed contributions, withholding on payments to freelancers and contractors, simplified regimes for small businesses, and expat and digital-nomad rules.
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Paid transport: quarterly final flat tax
rows.value: Paid transport operators not required to keep full accounts pay a final flat income tax each quarter: lorries BIF 39,000 (under 7 tonnes), BIF 54,000 (7 to 10 tonnes) or BIF 200,000 (over 10 tonnes); buses BIF 54,000 (over 35 seats), BIF 39,000 (18 to 35) or BIF 24,000 (12 to 18); car taxis BIF 20,000; motor tricycles and motorcycle taxis BIF 15,000.

rows.note: invoice amount excluding TVA, on payments to holders of public contracts (except advances); taxpayers with a tax clearance certificate (quitus fiscal) are exempt (art. 121).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/14 du 24 décembre 2020 portant modification de la loi n° 1/02 du 24 janvier 2013 relative aux impôts sur les revenus
rows.label: Withholding of 4% on payments to public contractors

rows.section: Customs: de minimis, import taxes and traveller allowances
rows.note: customs value of imports originating outside the African Union, except petroleum products and official, defence and donated imports (finance law art. 137).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Regional integration levy on imports from outside the African Union

rows.section: Customs: de minimis, import taxes and traveller allowances
rows.note: value of imported goods, except petroleum products and official, defence and donated imports (finance law art. 135).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Security levy on imports

rows.section: Customs: de minimis, import taxes and traveller allowances
rows.note: customs value of all imports, except imports exempt by law or treaty, by State-budget public services, fuel, listed foodstuffs and diplomatic imports (finance law art. 136).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Ad valorem tax of 1.5% on imports

rows.section: Customs: de minimis, import taxes and traveller allowances
rows.note: customs value of imports for resale, except fuel; an instalment of income tax (finance law art. 75).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Income tax prepayment of 3% on imports for resale

rows.section: Customs: de minimis, import taxes and traveller allowances
rows.note: customs value delivered to Burundi, paid by the importer (finance law art. 73); an IT fee of 0.25% of customs value is charged on each customs declaration (art. 110).
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Administrative fee of 1% on imports

rows.section: Customs: de minimis, import taxes and traveller allowances
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Import surtaxes on drinks, dairy, fabrics and building materials
rows.value: Surtaxes on the customs value of imports: beer and mineral or sparkling water 100% (plus a further 50% on beer), lemonades, sodas, non-alcoholic drinks and juices 25%, liquid milk and dairy products except powdered milk 30%, imported fabrics and mineral water a further 20%, corrugated sheets and nails not meeting EAC or COMESA origin rules 20%, steel bars, wood, plastic chairs and tables, A4 paper, wooden furniture, tubes and pipes 10%, tiles, cement, ceilings and maize 15%, ethyl alcohol 10%.

rows.section: Customs: de minimis, import taxes and traveller allowances
rows.source_title: Loi n° 1/10 du 30 juin 2026 portant fixation du budget général de l'État pour l'exercice 2026/2027
rows.label: Export tax on raw hides: 80% of FOB value or USD 0.52 per kg
rows.value: Raw hides and skins pay an export tax of 80% of the FOB value or USD 0.52 per kilogram, whichever is higher.
